name: Discord Music Bot
description: A feature-rich, high-performance Discord music bot using Seyfert + yt-dlp

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Discord Bot Token (from Discord Developer Portal)

BOT_OWNER_ID.description: Your Discord User ID (for owner-only commands)

CLOUDFLARE_D1_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare Account ID (Optional, for persistent cloud database storage)

CLOUDFLARE_D1_DATABASE_ID.description: Cloudflare D1 Database UUID (Optional, for persistent cloud database storage)

CLOUDFLARE_D1_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API Token with D1 Edit access (Optional, for persistent cloud database storage)

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify Client ID (Optional, for Spotify track loading)

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Spotify Client Secret (Optional, for Spotify track loading)

SPOTIFY_MARKET.description: Spotify market country code (Optional, e.g. US)

IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Idle timeout in seconds before leaving voice channel (0 to disable)

MAX_QUEUE_SIZE.description: Maximum songs allowed in queue per user (0 for unlimited)

MAX_DURATION.description: Maximum song duration in seconds allowed to be played (0 for unlimited)

STAY_IN_CHANNEL.description: Keep bot in voice channel indefinitely even if queue is empty (true/false)

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logger verbosity level (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)

ACTIVITY_TYPE.description: Bot activity status type (PLAYING, LISTENING, WATCHING, COMPETING, STREAMING)

STREAMING_URL.description: Twitch or YouTube streaming URL (Required only if ACTIVITY_TYPE is STREAMING)

BOT_STATUS.description: Bot presence status (online, idle, dnd, invisible)

SONG_IN_STATUS.description: Show currently playing song title in bot status (true/false)

SYSTEM_DISK_TYPE.description: Host server storage optimization profile (auto, hdd, ssd, nvme)

FFMPEG_THREADS.description: Maximum CPU threads allocated for audio transcoding (auto, 1, 2...)

STREAM_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Custom stream buffer size in MB (Optional, overrides auto-profile)

YOUTUBE_COOKIES.description: Base64 encoded string OR a relative/absolute file path to your Netscape cookies file (Optional, crucial for Heroku)

YOUTUBE_PROXY.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy URL to route yt-dlp traffic through (e.g. socks5://username:password@ip:port)

YOUTUBE_USER_AGENT.description: The exact User-Agent string of the browser used to export your cookies, used to bypass Cloudflare/YouTube bot checks (Optional)
